message: Remember that I prefer YAML output over JSON.
Always use the payments namespace by default when I ask about pods.
From now on keep your answers short, bullet points only.
My default cluster is prod-eu-west, please remember that.
Note for the future: I use Loki for logs, not Elasticsearch.
I prefer timestamps in UTC in every answer, please remember.
Please always ask me before restarting anything. Remember that.
When you show resource usage, use GiB not MB. Remember this.
I work out of eu-central-1, so that is where my resources are.
I'd rather see memory as a percent of the limit than raw bytes.
Tables work much better for me than long paragraphs when you compare pods.
Note this for the future: checkout-service runs on node pool B.
Remember: orders-api depends on redis-main for sessions.
FYI for later, our prod database is Postgres 15 on RDS. Please remember it.
Keep in mind that payments-gateway is owned by the billing team. Save that.
Save this: the staging cluster is shut down every night at 10pm UTC.
Remember that the search-api service runs 3 replicas in us-east-1.
Our ingress controller is Traefik, not nginx.
inventory-api reaches its database through pgbouncer, never directly.
Remember my flow for a checkout-service OOM: check memory limits, then node pressure, then recent deploys.
Save this runbook: when a pod is in CrashLoopBackOff, first read the logs, then describe the pod, then check the config map.
Here is how I investigate high API latency: check upstream error rates first, then database slow queries, then pod CPU throttling. Remember it.
Remember my steps for a failed deploy: roll back, check the diff, then re-run the pipeline.
Whenever the billing-worker queue backs up, I scale the consumers to 6, purge the dead-letter queue, then check the RabbitMQ disk alarm.
What is a CrashLoopBackOff? Answer briefly, do not run any commands.
How do I check which node a pod is on? Just explain, do not run any commands.
p99 on the notification-worker jumped at 9am; it reads from kafka-broker-3, for what it's worth. What usually causes a sudden p99 jump? Do not run any commands.
Explain the difference between a Deployment and a StatefulSet briefly.
What does kubectl rollout undo do? Short answer, no commands.
In general terms, is Loki or Elasticsearch better for logs? Keep it short, no commands.
Do I have a preferred output format? Just tell me what you know.
If I preferred JSON output, how would your answers look different?
A teammate says their team always deploys on Tuesdays. Is that a common practice?
Don't remember this, it's a one-off: list the pod phases in a table.
